title: Rav Nachman of Nehardea
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Chullin 95b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.95b.16): he visited Rav Kahana at Pum Nahara on the eve of Yom Kippur. The supplied notice has Rav Nachman tell him, “Take and eat,” etc. Hyman reports that [the Rashba’s Chullin commentary](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashba_on_Chullin.95a.3) reads Rav Chanan of Nehardea.

notes.text: The Gemara names Rav Nachman as the visitor and gives the invitation without naming the speaker. The accompanying English takes Rav Kahana to be the speaker.

The [printed Hyman, vol. III, p. 945](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/ba/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._III._1910.pdf#page=112) has א״ל ר״כ, “Rav Kahana said to him.” The supplied Hebrew transcription has ר״נ, Rav Nachman, which the translation follows above.

The linked Rashba has Rav Kahana tell Rav Chanan to take the meat. Hyman gives the fuller name “Rav Chanan of Nehardea.” [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2696&lang=en) sends readers from his Nachman of Nehardea entry to his entry for Chanan of Nehardea.
